entities.name: George Christian, Prince of Lobkowicz

entities.summary: Johann Georg Christian, Prince of Lobkowicz, was an Austrian field marshal. He was a member of the old Bohemian noble Lobkowicz family, of which he established a cadet branch, the Hořín–Mělník line.
